introduction: 大学生Wan有一个狂热的爱好，跟随并拍摄了《后起之秀》第九。当Wan在他的偶像将出演的Y系列赛中获得支持角色的演员机会时，他遇到了第三名，这是一个尖锐的领导人和九船伙伴。两人立即发生冲突，但是当Wan通过试镜时，两人被迫一起工作。尽管他们彼此不喜欢，但在了解第三名后，Wan开始以不同的眼光看待他的竞争对手。他不知道自己怎么了，但是他发现自己越来越频繁地避开了众多的领导者的目光。除此之外，Wan开始得知在窗帘后面，看起来如此出色的行业并不是他所想的。即使是九个人，他自己的偶像也在隐藏一些阴暗的东西。 ~~改编自小说“ Fanboy先生”（Fanboy Mr.＃รักสุดใจนายแฟนบอย），由Littlebbear96University student Wan has a fanboy hobby, following and photographing rising star Nine. When Wan gets a casting opportunity for a support role in a Y series his idol will be starring in, he meets Third, a sharp-tongued leading man and Nine's ship partner. The two clash immediately, but when Wan passes his audition, the two are forced to work together. Despite their dislike for one another, after getting to know Third, Wan starts to look at his rival in a different light. He doesn't know what's wrong with him, but he finds himself avoiding the cocky leading man's gaze more and more often.Beyond that, Wan comes to learn that behind the curtain, the industry that looked so splendid isn't all as he'd thought. Even Nine, his own idol, is hiding something shady.~~ Adapted from the novel "Mr. Fanboy" (Mr. Fanboy #รักสุดใจนายแฟนบอย) by littlebbear96
